in_marathi.name: Kshemanidhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshemanidhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the words 'kshema' meaning 'prosperity' and 'nidhi' meaning 'goddess', Kshemanidhi is the name of the goddess of prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Kshemanidhi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kshemanidhi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the words 'kshema' meaning 'prosperity' and 'nidhi' meaning 'goddess', Kshemanidhi is the name of the goddess of prosperity.
